metadata.description: Neva plugin marketplace: an honest second brain plus a disciplined coding harness.

plugins.name: neva-core
plugins.description: Process, memory and learning core: plan, test, implement, review, verify, remember, improve. Agent orchestration, eval and security harnesses. Always on.

plugins.name: neva-web
plugins.description: Web stack: PHP/Laravel, TypeScript, React, Next, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, NestJS, Bun, Vite; Postgres, MySQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Prisma; API design, accessibility, design systems, motion, slides.

plugins.name: neva-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile: Flutter/Dart, Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin/Android and Compose Multiplatform, React Native/Expo, HarmonyOS/ArkTS.

plugins.name: neva-backend-langs
plugins.description: Server languages: Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery), Go, Rust, Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus, JPA), Kotlin server (Ktor, Exposed), C++, C#/.NET, F#, Perl, Rails.

plugins.name: neva-ops
plugins.description: Docker, Kubernetes, deployment and canary checks, homelab and network engineering (VLAN, WireGuard, DNS, BGP, Cisco IOS), Flox, PM2, terminal ops.

plugins.name: neva-business
plugins.description: Research, content, SEO and marketing, brand, investor materials, social publishing, email and messaging ops, billing, agreements, workspace and GitHub/Jira ops.

plugins.name: neva-media
plugins.description: Video editing and generation (Remotion, Manim, VideoDB, fal.ai), Blender motion, taste and style packs, UI demo recordings, document processing and translation.

plugins.name: neva-domains
plugins.description: Healthcare and HIPAA, supply chain and manufacturing, ML engineering and recsys, bioinformatics lookups, DeFi/EVM security, agent payments, prediction markets.
